name: Knock Knock [FOREST]
desc:
In Knock Knock, you have to prank your neighbor by knocking and running away! However... your neighbor is a little unusual. In this game you:

1. Knock on their door
2. Run
3. Get money from getting chased
4. Buy traps 

Controls:
B/L1 - Emote
Shift/ButtonY - Run
Ctrl/ButtonX - Crawl

Please like if you enjoyed! If you disliked please leave feedback.

Contains flashing lights

Tags: Amber Alert, Horror, Scary, Ding Dong Ditch
